items.resolutionReason: Held for a candy-like regular oval under broad colour bands. Two revision rounds, each reviewed across a 24-yaw, three-pitch gallery orbit plus a top-down. Round one broke the outline into a real seam with rock tongues cutting into the lens, but painted the fire into the albedo as flat saturated tiles that did not move through a full turn.
